doc: 128x64 pattern to 48x24: 128 is not a multiple of 48, so the box branch is not taken and the surface is sampled bilinearly through sample_equirect at the texel-center directions of the 48x24 grid (longitude wraps at the antimeridian, latitude clamps at the poles; no pre-filtering). A float64 formula rounded to float32: default tolerance, measured worst difference against an analytic-index float64 evaluation 1.1e-7 (one float32 ulp).
